description: This file defines the LiveActivityManager class responsible for managing Live Activities related to connection states within an iOS application. It handles starting, reconnecting, disconnecting, and lifecycle management of activities using ActivityKit, including cleanup of stale activities.

classes.name: LiveActivityManager
classes.description: A singleton class that manages live activities, including starting, updating, and cleaning up activities related to an openClaw session.

methods.name: startActivity
methods.description: Initializes and requests a new live activity with given agentName and sessionKey, or handles the existing activity if one is active.

methods.name: handleConnecting
methods.description: Updates the current activity's state to indicate a connecting status.

methods.name: handleReconnect
methods.description: Updates the current activity's state to idle, indicating reconnection process.

methods.name: handleDisconnect
methods.description: Updates the current activity's state to disconnected.

methods.name: hydrateCurrentAndPruneDuplicates
methods.description: Ensures only the latest activity remains active by pruning duplicates and updating the current activity reference.

methods.name: updateCurrent
methods.description: Updates the current activity's state with provided content state.

methods.name: connectingState
methods.description: Returns the content state indicating 'Connecting...' status.

methods.name: idleState
methods.description: Returns the content state indicating 'Idle' status.

methods.name: disconnectedState
methods.description: Returns the content state indicating 'Disconnected' status.
